zh-CN.title: 四个页面，同一套自适应面板
items: 聊天、广场、通讯与菜单统一按可用空间调整面板，单面板不再限制手机宽度
平板使用紧凑左侧导航，分栏面板不再遮挡其他区域；广场单面板完整展示正文与评论

en.title: One adaptive workspace across four tabs
items: Chats, Square, contacts and menu now share adaptive panels; single panels expand beyond phone width
Tablets use compact side navigation, docked panels no longer mask other content, and single-pane Square details include the full post
